Připravenost po dnech. Pod grafem otevře: Readiness day by day. Below the chart, open sleep, HRV and resting heart rate from your watch, always against your own norm. Days without a night from the watch stay empty in the chart.
Váš pocit z běhu je jeden z nejcitlivějš: How a run felt is one of the most sensitive signs of fatigue. The app weighs it the most.
Zhoršující se pocit z běhů se často obje: Runs feeling worse often shows up before any change in the watch data.
Běh na pásu se automaticky nepočítá do m: A treadmill run is automatically left out of mechanics, because its metrics differed markedly from your norm on outdoor runs
